yowl.description: Yowls when the Windows drive runs low on room: a schedule, a condition, two buttons.
yowl.title: Yowl
yowl.blurb: Every ten minutes Yowl looks at how much room the Windows drive has left. Under the line, a warning goes up with two buttons and stays until there is room again or you ask for quiet.
yowl.notify.title: {0} is running out of room
yowl.notify.message: {0} GB free; the line is {1} GB.
